newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Oman IPO fund 40 pct oversubscribed - BIB.
newsitem.headline: Oman IPO fund 40 pct oversubscribed - BIB.

text.p: Bahrain International Bank said on Monday the new Muscat Special Initial Public Offering Fund had been oversubscribed by 40 percent above the maximum $25 million it could legally raise.

BIB's Group Managing Director, Corporate Finance, David Knights said in a statement the fund, which opened for subscription in mid-May and closed on June 12, attracted an overwhelming response from Gulf investors.
The success of the Muscat Special IPO Fund would encourage BIB to raise more such funds, Knights said.
BIB said earlier the fund was jointly structured with Bank Muscat al-Ahli al-Omani to give investors a chance to take part in new flotations in the booming Omani equity market.
